name: Kowloon–Canton Railway · northern core approach
广九铁路核心区北段
lines.reason: Join the observed core main line and use the depression west of the hill shoulder toward the Buji vicinity. Detail weakens at the film edge; the station reference is not the period platform.

name: Kowloon–Canton Railway · Buji toward Pinghu
广九铁路布吉至平湖方向
lines.reason: Most of this leg is north of usable registered imagery. Approximate valley route from the county rail diagram, constrained by the station vicinities. Not the modern doubled or widened line.

name: Kowloon–Canton Railway · northern continuation
广九铁路继续向北
lines.reason: County sheet shows the railway continuing toward Dongguan. Stop at a review portal north of Pinghu; the model does not assign a historical boundary point.

name: Lo Wu rail approach · Hong Kong context
罗湖铁路南引道（香港背景）
lines.reason: Continue the existing route south from the core edge to the visible valley approach. Context only; no station-platform or surveyed alignment claim.

name: Old Guangzhou–Shenzhen road · Nantou–town approach
旧广深公路南头至深圳镇进路
lines.reason: Follow the county sheet's coastal-side route through Nantou and the Futian lowlands, south of the visible cleared strip where plausible. Joining the unnamed core southern link is an aerial model assumption, not identification of that trace.

name: Old Guangzhou–Shenzhen road · Bao’an lowland corridor
旧广深公路宝安低地段
lines.reason: Guide an aerial estimate through the county sheet’s coastal towns, using the lowland side of the Fuyong ridge and avoiding obvious period offshore water. Alignment north of the KH-9 edge is much less constrained; no modern highway widths or interchanges are implied.

name: Cleared east–west corridor · west of Shangbu
上步以西东西向开挖带
lines.reason: Follow the broad bright strip visible westward from the core works. Shennan is context, not proof the full strip was paved or in service. End at the last continuous visible cut in this pass.

name: Shenzhen River · downstream continuation
深圳河下游延伸
lines.reason: Approximate the continuous dark channel and western tidal approach picked from the registered regional frame. Does not define either bank, the border or a tide datum.

name: Chiwan vicinity · shore-side fabric candidate
赤湾附近沿岸建成纹理候选区
areas.reason: Conservative textured pocket inland of the south-facing bay; the modern village point falls in comparator water and was not used to place roofs. Not the identified old village, temple or industrial port.
areas.reasonZh: 取南向海湾内陆一处纹理斑块。现代赤湾点落在对照水体中，未用于建筑落位；不认定为旧村、庙宇或工业港。

name: Shatoujiao vicinity · shore-side fabric candidate
沙头角附近沿岸建成纹理候选区
areas.reason: Coarse roof-texture pocket beside the historic bay. No allocation to either side of a boundary, no Zhongying Street footprint, and no modern fill.
areas.reasonZh: 历史海湾旁的粗略屋顶纹理。未划分边界两侧，不代表中英街轮廓，也不使用现代填海地。

name: Nantou · built-up envelope
南头建成区轮廓
areas.reason: Coarse cluster near the old town, not wall survival or parcels.

name: Shekou · shore-side built-up pockets
蛇口沿岸建成地
areas.reason: Approximate built-up coast pockets on the September image; not a fishing-harbour or industrial parcel outline.

name: Built-up pockets toward Sungang
笋岗方向建成地斑块
areas.reason: Broad roof texture near the north rail corridor, not the boundary of Sungang village.

name: Southern Futian · field and pond-pattern lowland
福田南部田塘状低地
areas.reason: Broad visual field-and-pond pattern; not use, a cadastral boundary or a crop claim.

name: Western foreshore · lowland grid
西部沿岸低地网格
areas.reason: Broad regular pattern on the image; keep unclassified where it overlaps observed water.
